reviews.text:
The vet and nurses are all very kind, and I've been a patient there many times!

I've also had my dog ​​groomed there several times, and he always comes back looking adorable! ☺︎

I visited for a second opinion (I informed them it was a second opinion), and they explained everything carefully without showing any displeasure.
The first hospital was also very good, but I came to this hospital because I wanted to try a different insulin than the one they used (Tresiba).
(Nishi-Nippori Animal Hospital used ProZinc.)
It will be administered twice a day, but my cat seems much more comfortable with it.
*I sought a second opinion because Tresiba caused redness of the skin, lethargy, diarrhea, and other symptoms, which I suspected might be an allergy.

They also have a blood glucose monitor, which I thought would allow them to approach my cat's care from a different perspective.
I was hesitant, but I'm glad I sought a second opinion.
Thank you so much, Nishi-Nippori Animal Hospital.
This is a kind and attentive hospital that treats dogs with gentleness.
The veterinarians and nurses provide accurate treatment and are very supportive of the pet owners. I also think the prices are reasonable.

The doctor and all the staff are so kind, I feel at ease.
This is the animal hospital I've been going to for 12 years.
My cat almost had its nipples cut off.

The doctors and everyone working at the hospital are so kind. 😊
My dog ​​loves the kind doctors, so he always looks happy when he goes to the hospital, even though it's just a hospital! 🐶

They don't just prescribe medications without thinking. They carefully assess the dog's symptoms and physical condition to determine whether or not medication is necessary. ✨
They really care about your dog!
It's so reassuring. 😊

This hospital allows you to entrust your pet to their care with peace of mind, as they will explain the condition and treatment until you are completely satisfied. Both the doctors and nurses treat animals with kindness.
They were very kind and taught me many things.
The staff and doctors are all very friendly, and the low prices are also great, so I feel at ease knowing I can get treatment.

My dog's ears were cleaned, his nails clipped, and his anal glands expressed.
The grooming set cost 1,100 yen.
I was a little worried as it was my first visit, but I was relieved to see that he wasn't shaking.
He was given a great cleaning! Thank you very much.

Our 1.5-year-old dog has been receiving excellent care here since puppyhood.

Whenever something happens, even if we call on the same day or on a holiday, they always come to see our dog despite their busy schedule.

The doctor, staff, and groomers are all so kind that our dog loves this clinic and always wants to go.

I think it's thanks to them that our dog has become a vet-loving dog!

We always entrust them with everything from pet boarding to shampooing, and we are truly grateful for their exceptional service.

We look forward to continuing to use their services!
Very kind doctors and nurses having good experiences. Really recommend.
